experiment: E65 per-trial per-band channel-standardized correlation logSPD

features.main_variable: Within every trial and FFT-isolated band, subtract each channel mean and divide by that channel's own sample standard deviation (ddof=1), then form the 18x18 correlation matrix. All later E36 shrinkage/logm/upper-triangle/detrend/zband operations are unchanged.

protocol.source: E58 ten inner runs and E54 subject roles
protocol.roles: outer_unknown=4, enrolled=8, oe_only=4, calibration_eval_unknown=4; pairwise disjoint
protocol.aggregation: two inner runs averaged within each outer group, then five outer groups averaged
protocol.baseline: E36 detrend_zband covariance logSPD/WCCN refit on exactly the same fit trials; identity scores and attack waveforms shared with correlation variant

identity.inner_source: E54 ten frozen oe_inner EEGNet artifacts; no E65 training or parameter changes
identity.final20_source: E64 frozen ten-backbone/20-class equal-weight CNN ensemble, including its 20-class prototypes; only logSPD/WCCN and dr are replaced

decision.rule: dr>=tau_high -> logSPD identity; tau_low<=dr<tau_high -> OE-EEGNet identity; dr<tau_low -> 0
decision.threshold_source: clean known dr only; no pseudo-unknown or Test threshold tuning
decision.U_at_95_definition: unknown fraction with dr<tau_high, where tau_high is clean-known q05; diagnostic rejection threshold, not the three-region high-dr identity route
decision.working_U_definition: unknown fraction rejected by dr<tau_low in the actual three-region rule

attacks.attack_target: CNN/OE-EEGNet only; frozen waveform is then scored by both logSPD variants
attacks.scope_warning: CNN-only white-box PGD20-style transfer through the decision chain, not a full-chain adaptive attack; no E65 adversarial training

test_gate.if_any_clean_gate_fails: Test=N/A; do not read Test and do not create predictions

test_audit.session_read_timing: only after all predictions and CSV are written

reporting.AUC: clean pseudo-unknown detection AUROC; larger dr means known
reporting.F1: registered identity macro-F1 direct and with rejection; unknown-class F1 and joint macro-F1 reported separately
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train session1 pseudo-unknown subjects and continuous within-session blocks only; not cross-session or official Test truth evidence
